name: delta-b
prompt: Using the reference image ONLY for its glossy white plastic material, crisp specular highlight style, soft rounded toy-like modelling and exact top-down view: create a sleek supersonic jet glyph on a fully transparent background, seen exactly from directly above, nose pointing to the upper right at 45 degrees, centred. Shape: very long slim needle fuselage; a slender ogee delta wing that starts only at the middle of the fuselage and grows smoothly backwards to the tail, so the plane is much longer than it is wide (span about half the length), with a straight trailing edge flush with the tail and small rounded wing tips; nothing sticks out forward of the wing; a thin fin line. From two small round exhaust nozzles at the very rear, two separate thin soft flame trails stream backwards toward the lower left corner: coral orange outer glow (#FF8A4C to #EE4E2B) with a warm pale yellow core, fading smoothly to fully transparent. The whole thing including flames fills about 80 percent of the frame. No shadow, no background.
